# AVA-DAM

> AVA-DAM builds websites, software, motion videos and interactive maps. The ideas are ours, the build is done with AI. Based in Trimbach (Switzerland) and Grantown-on-Spey (Scotland).

AVA-DAM is the joint label of Adrian von Arb and Daniel Muccio. The name is pronounced like "Adam": a reminder of the first human being, where everything began, including the age of AI. Slogan: Human + Technology. Together.

## About us

We are Adi and Dani. Between us we bring a lot of experience, from HR training through marketing and sales support to security and surveillance. Add to that roles as deputy managing director and CEO in medium-sized companies, and successfully building several businesses in Switzerland and the UK.
Adi has been a passionate photographer for years and more recently has also been working as a filmmaker. In Scotland, Dani is building further businesses in accommodation and self-catering.
AVA-DAM brings all of this together. We know day-to-day business life from the inside, and that is exactly who we build our websites and tools for.

## What we do
- Websites: Clear, fast websites that work just as well on a phone as on a computer. Built from day one so that Google and AI search can find and understand them.
- Software and tools: Software for real-world workflows. GuardOpS grew out of 22 years in the security industry. We build what we would have needed ourselves.
- Motion videos: Short animated videos for social media and websites. The story and the pictures in our heads are ours, AI helps us bring them to life.
- Interactive maps: Maps that let Guests and customers explore on their own, with travel times, categories and the hosts' personal tips.

## Projects
- [VKU Oberbaselbiet](https://avadam26.github.io/vku-entwurf/): A shared website for eight driving instructors offering traffic awareness and first aid courses. Dates, venues and sign-up in one place.
- [Butterfly Cottage](https://www.butterfly-cottage.co.uk): Website for a holiday cottage for two in Grantown-on-Spey, right in the Cairngorms National Park. Personal, warm and with direct booking.
- [Grantown map](https://www.butterfly-cottage.co.uk/grantown/grantown-map.html): More than 50 places to visit around Grantown-on-Spey, most of them under 90 minutes away. With travel times, categories and the hosts' favourite spots.
- [GuardOpS](https://guardops.ch/): Operations software for small and medium-sized Swiss security companies. Shift planning, staff app, patrol checks with NFC or geofence, customer portal and invoices with Swiss QR bills.
